context:
Goal: no PR waits forever.
Problem (cannot undo): runner 8 holds 10 claude-settings PRs as held after review round 3 (decision hold-unsafe-after-round-3), with no hold reason recorded. The ten: #1099 (refuse a lane commit that undoes its own earlier work), #1141 (local triage tier proof, likely replaced by #1378), #1143 (refuse a push to an agent's own worktree branch), #1147 and #1177 (timing tests; your 13:00 CST ruling covers #1177), #1166 (merge -C flag), #1170 (parked-line id guard), #1179 (removed CLI flag cites), #1181 (design-branch delete guard), #1186 (guards read interpreter strings only at shell spots).
Based on (read): runner 8's held list, 13:09 CST; the idle-PR audit found most of these reviewed and 1,100-1,900 commits behind main.
Departs from: main, where the held PRs sit parked — a sends each back to a revive lane for a fresh round-1 review on top of main.
Meanwhile the lanes stop all work on these ten.

options.gain: Each catches up with main, gets a fresh review, then batches alone, or closes if it is out of date. Nothing sits parked silently.
options.label: Release all ten to the revive lanes (recommended)
options.lose: Lane work on ten guard PRs.

options.label: Release them one by one, with a yes or no on each

reply: a, saved 13:12 CST. Sent to the coordinator: all ten held PRs go back to the revive lanes, each catches up with main and gets a fresh round-1 review, then batches alone or closes if out of date.
short: 10 held PRs: release, one by one, or close
title: Release the ten held claude-settings PRs to the revive lanes?
why: Only you can release a PR held after review round 3, and none of the ten has a recorded hold reason.
